name: Azure Monitor Metrics Query
purpose: Query Azure Monitor for infrastructure metrics with resource, aggregation, and threshold filtering.

parameters.name: service
parameters.description: Azure resource type e.g. vm, sql, functions, aks

parameters.name: resource-group
parameters.description: Azure resource group name or empty

parameters.name: metric
parameters.description: Azure metric name e.g. Percentage CPU, Available Memory Bytes

parameters.name: resource
parameters.description: specific resource name or empty for all in group

parameters.name: threshold
parameters.description: threshold condition e.g. >80 — empty if no threshold

parameters.name: profiles
parameters.description: Azure profile name from Cloud Profile context
